soundtrack.title: Silo 18 — 10 minute seamless loop
soundtrack.origin: Supplied by the repository owner. Not taken from the television production.
soundtrack.sourceFormat: MPEG-1 Layer III, 320 kbps CBR, 48 kHz stereo, 24,001,964 bytes
soundtrack.format: MPEG-1 Layer III, VBR ~113 kbps, 44.1 kHz stereo
soundtrack.encodeNote: Re-encoded from the supplied 24 MB master for web delivery. Measured spectral error against the master is 0.006 with full bandwidth to 22 kHz retained; the 8.1 MiB result is fetched in the background so it never delays entering the silo.
soundtrack.loop: Genuinely gapless. The master runs at full level from its first sample to its last and the butt-join discontinuity (0.006) is smaller than the largest neighbouring-sample delta in the material (0.023), so it joins onto itself inaudibly. audio.js still trims any codec padding at runtime before setting loopStart/loopEnd.
soundtrack.playback: Decoded once into an AudioBuffer and looped on a single source node, so travelling between levels never restarts or ducks it.

synthesised.note: Everything else you hear is generated at runtime in dist/src/audio.js — footsteps, doors, the airlock, the lens wipe, interface sounds, the hum, ventilation, wind, turbine throb, the shaft reverb and the occasional creaks, drips and distant clanks. No other audio file is bundled.
synthesised.reverb: A 2.1 s synthetic impulse response built at load time; no reverb sample is shipped.
